definitions.gloss: revolution; orbital motion of one body around another
definitions.explanation: In astronomy, the orbital motion of one body around another — typically a planet around its star or a moon around its planet. Distinct from {自転|じてん} ("rotation on the body's own axis"). Earth's annual {公転|こうてん} around the Sun produces the seasons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{公転|こうてん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Earth revolves around the Sun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{公転|こうてん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Moon revolves around the Earth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{公転|こうてん}⟦{周期|しゅうき}→周期：21707_shuuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧365⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧だ。
examples.english: Earth's orbital period is about 365 days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自転|じてん}→自転：27358_jiten⟧⟦{軸|じく}→軸：14304_jiku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{傾|かたむ}いた→傾く：00200_katamuku⟧まま⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{公転|こうてん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|しょう}じる→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧。
examples.english: The seasons arise because the Earth orbits the Sun while keeping its rotation axis tilted.

notes:
{公転|こうてん} is the standard astronomical term for orbital revolution — one body moving around another under gravity. It is taught and used as a pair with ⟦{自転|じてん}→自転：27358_jiten⟧ ("rotation on the body's own axis"); Japanese science textbooks contrast the two side by side.

FORMS:
- {公|こう} (here functioning roughly as "public, around a center") + {転|てん} ("turn, revolve") → {公転|こうてん}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公転|こうてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to revolve, to orbit
- {公転|こうてん}⟦{周期|しゅうき}→周期：21707_shuuki⟧: orbital period
- {公転|こうてん}⟦{軌道|きどう}→軌道：06360_kidou⟧: orbital path
- {公転|こうてん}⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧: orbital speed
- ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{公転|こうてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to orbit the Sun
- ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{公転|こうてん}: the Earth's revolution

CONTRAST WITH {自転|じてん}:
- ⟦{自転|じてん}→自転：27358_jiten⟧: rotation on its own axis — produces day and night
- {公転|こうてん}: revolution around another body — produces the year, the seasons (when combined with axial tilt), and the lunar month
- The two are usually introduced together; "⟦{自転|じてん}→自転：27358_jiten⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{公転|こうてん}" is essentially a fixed phrase in astronomy class.

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{軌道|きどう}→軌道：06360_kidou⟧: orbit (the path itself, as a noun)
- ⟦{周回|しゅうかい}→周回：14812_shuukai⟧: circling around (used for satellites, e.g., ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{周回|しゅうかい}→周回：14812_shuukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧)
- ⟦{回転|かいてん}→回転：00141_kaiten⟧: rotation, turning (general, non-astronomical use)
- ⟦{太陽系|たいようけい}→太陽系：12216_taiyoukei⟧: the solar system

USAGE:
- {公転|こうてん} is restricted to astronomy and physics. For "go around" in everyday contexts, {周|まわ}る or ⟦{周回|しゅうかい}→周回：14812_shuukai⟧ is used: ⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{周|まわ}る ("to go around the lake").
- The pattern is typically [orbiting body]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧[central body]⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{公転|こうてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{公転|こうてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.
- Several homophones share the reading こうてん: ⟦{好転|こうてん}→好転：17466_kouten⟧ ("a turn for the better"), ⟦{交点|こうてん}→交点：24562_kouten⟧ ("point of intersection"), ⟦{荒天|こうてん}→荒天：16432_kouten⟧ ("stormy weather"). Distinguish them by kanji and context.
